specification.gate: All six fixture/checkpoint preflights complete before any world ranking or training. The stack-12 fixture must pass its full 4,000-iteration preflight and accuracy target. Resource-cap rejections are retained with exact reason and census and never trigger fallback or fixture/limit changes. For any admitted 4,000-iteration fixture, every measured final repeat must meet NashConv + 1e-10 <= 0.005 and improve the first-checkpoint gap; misses are recorded as failures. Independently replay every measured profile's ordered future outcomes, physical pair priors, action amounts/targets, visible-information values and legal best responses within 1e-10. The stack-24 fixture additionally requires both declared non-all-in multi-raise action sequences when its 4,000-iteration solve is admitted. Complete-call payloads must be deterministic at repeated final checkpoints.
specification.model_limits: Heads-up fixed-flop finite betting tree with all 58 compatible pairs from the specified 8x8 physical combo ranges and the complete hidden future deck (1,980 ordered turn/river outcomes per pair), followed by forced checkdown. No later-street betting, preflop, rake or multiway equilibrium.
specification.provenance: Independently developed benchmark using existing OpenPoker kernels and an independent ordered-future/best-five numeric-rule replay. TexasSolver's public console README is configuration-shape inspiration only: https://github.com/bupticybee/TexasSolver/tree/console. This is a different forced-checkdown game abstraction and is not an equivalent-game comparison, runtime comparison, or accuracy comparison. No third-party source or dependencies are incorporated.

timing_scope: One complete solve plus JSON serialization at 100 and 1,000 iterations; three separate complete solves at 4,000 iterations. Source preparation, tree/work admission, ranking, training, exact diagnostics and serialization are timed; independent replay is outside timing.
allocation_scope: One separate complete 4,000-iteration solve plus JSON serialization per admitted fixture under tracemalloc. Python traced allocations, not RSS. No 10-iteration substitute.
quality_scope: Every measured policy is replayed against independently enumerated ordered future boards, independently ranked best-five hands, numeric betting rules, exact physical pair priors and legal own-hand best responses. TexasSolver is configuration inspiration only; no equivalent-game or performance comparison is claimed.
